body:
Comparing a `Categorical` with an iterator raised `TypeError: object of type '...' has no len()`: the length check ran before the hashability check, and an iterator is hashable. It now takes the same scalar-like path a tuple already does.

Related: GH-31646. The remaining cases there (e.g. `IntervalArray`/`IntegerArray` `==` an iterator) already emit the GH-62423 warning and will treat the iterator as scalar-like once that deprecation is enforced in 4.0.

AI disclosure: drafted with Claude Code (`claude opus 5 (high)`), which wrote the fix and tests and then reviewed the branch over several rounds; all findings were verified against a pre-branch build before being acted on.
title: BUG: treat an iterator as scalar-like in Categorical comparisons (GH#31646)
